_comment: Fritz's second missing woodcutter (content-zone-2-woodland.md §3.5 quest 4): find Woodcutter 2, a prisoner on the kobold plateau, and bring Fritz the news. Woodcutter 2 teaches Hatchet on her own row, so the reward here is XP only. Priced at L8 by the L9 half-level rule (the plateau's band).
